assumptions: In-tree `vmaf` crate score_v1_420: features = cambi_v1_from_luma (distorted only) + speed_v1_chroma_420 + adm3_v1_from_luma + motion3(=0) (score.rs:95-135).
CAMBI runs 5 scales with in-place even decimation + 3x3 mode filter + histogram-windowed c_values (cambi.rs:5917-5985); per-elem splits are stage estimates (window_size<=65, num_diffs=4).
SpEED chroma at quarter res x2 planes; stage estimate.
v0 (vif/adm2) features are NOT part of v1; adm3 shares compute_adm structure.
Written before reading swe's vmaf tallies (read-after-write rule).

stages.name: RGB8 -> YUV420 u8 planes (709)
stages.notes: BT.709 path: r/255 div x3, lum 3mul+2add, (16+219L).round().clamp(16,235); chroma: 2 sums x(3mul+2add)/px, 224*u/4 + 128 round clamp(16,240) per 2x2. Stage estimate over fused per-2x2-block loop.

stages.name: ADM DWT2 scale0 x2img
stages.notes: 4-tap lo/hi vertical (2x(4mul+3add+shift) per col) + horizontal 4 outputs x(4mul+3add); stage estimate [adm3_v1: same compute_adm, v1 settings] (mul/add folded into int: fixed-point pipeline)

stages.name: ADM DWT2 scales1-3 combined x2img
stages.notes: i32 a-band -> h/v/d bands + next a; same 4-tap structure [adm3_v1: same compute_adm, v1 settings] (mul/add folded into int: fixed-point pipeline)

stages.name: ADM decouple r/a x4scales x3bands
stages.notes: per band-px: ot_dp/o_mag/t_mag i64 dots, angle flag, div LUT + gain, r/a writes; stage estimate [adm3_v1: same compute_adm, v1 settings] (mul/add folded into int: fixed-point pipeline)

stages.name: ADM csf_i16 x3bands x4scales
stages.notes: rfactor mul+shift per band -> dst + flt [adm3_v1: same compute_adm, v1 settings] (mul/add folded into int: fixed-point pipeline)

stages.name: ADM cm_i16 + den_scale x4scales
stages.notes: 3-row window sums + xsq/xcub shifted accum + den estimate; stage estimate [adm3_v1: same compute_adm, v1 settings] (mul/add folded into int: fixed-point pipeline)

stages.name: u8->10bit luma copy
stages.notes: shift to 10-bit into pooled buffer (mul/add folded into int: fixed-point pipeline)

stages.name: 2x2 box anti-dither (in-place)
stages.notes: sum 4 taps >>2 in place (mul/add folded into int: fixed-point pipeline)

stages.name: spatial mask: deriv+DP+compare (7x7)
stages.notes: derivative_row cmp + compute_dp_row prefix (2 adds) + compute_mask_row window-sum compare (4 adds+cmp); MASK_FILTER_SIZE=7 (mul/add folded into int: fixed-point pipeline)

stages.name: per-scale decimate+mode3+c_values+pool (5 scales)
stages.notes: stage estimate: decimate x2 (~2) + filter_mode 3x3 mode3 (~6) + histogram window update ~65 adds/masked px (window_size<=65) + c_value_pixel 4 diffs x ~10 (tvi cmp, 2 hist loads, mul, LUT recip, max) + top-60% spatial pooling ~5

stages.name: SpEED chroma u+v (quarter res)
stages.notes: per chroma plane: antialiased prescale + 5x5-block covariance stats + per-block eigen solve; stage estimate at quarter res x2 planes

stages.name: motion3 single-frame (zero)
stages.notes: single frame: validation scan only; motion3=0 (mul/add folded into int: fixed-point pipeline)

stages.name: v1 SVM predict + clip
stages.notes: v1 feature vector (cambi,speed_u? combined speed_uv,adm3,motion3); per-SV RBF cost NSV x (dim sub+mul+add + mul+exp+add) — NSV is model data, counted at 1 SV
